week.name: Saturday
week.detailed: Rain before 8am, then rain and snow between 8am and 5pm. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 46. Northwest wind around 2 mph. Chance of precipitation is 100%. New rainfall amounts between a tenth and quarter of an inch possible.

week.name: Sunday
week.detailed: Mostly sunny, with a high near 53. South southwest wind around 3 mph.

week.name: Monday
week.detailed: Mostly sunny, with a high near 55.

week.name: Tuesday
week.detailed: Rain. Cloudy, with a high near 48.

week.name: Wednesday
week.detailed: A chance of snow before 11am, then a chance of rain and snow. Partly sunny, with a high near 42. Little or no snow accumulation expected.

week.name: Thursday
week.detailed: Snow likely before 11am, then rain and snow likely. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 41. New snow accumulation of less than half an inch possible.

discussion.key_messages: - Precipitation becomes more widespread overnight with snow levels dropping to ~6500 feet behind a cold front that arrives Saturday morning, bringing a line of heavier precipitation. - Accumulating snow is expected in all mountain areas, especially above 8000 feet, and a Winter Weather Advisory is in effect across the southern mountains. - Two colder storms arrive next week with the potential for some valley snowfall.

rules_take: Beaver Mountain: the forecasts put 2–16 in. over the next 7 days (middle 6 in.), and they disagree a lot. About <1 in. of that lands in the next 72 hours. The NWS forecasters have 10 in. for the week.
